tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask the agent. Full pipeline (schema, queries, analysis). Sync within deadline_seconds; else {status:pending,job_id} — poll request_status/read_response. Pass a stable thread id (UUID) on every call for conversation context. The result carries thread_id, the thread actually used; re-send that value

tools.name: help
tools.description: Short orientation text for apples MCP callers.

tools.name: read_response
tools.description: Stream a chunk of a pending ask() job's output.

tools.name: request_status
tools.description: Check the status of a pending ask() job.
